1.translation: When the earth is shaken with a mighty quake,

2.translation: and the earth throws out its burdens[1],
2.footnotes: [1] i.e., its dead bodies and treasures.

3.translation: and man says[2], “What is the matter with it?”

4.translation: On that Day it will recount all its news,

5.translation: because your Lord has inspired it [to do so].

6.translation: On that Day all people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds[3].
6.footnotes: [3] From the place of Judgment to see the consequences of their deeds, whether to Paradise or to Hell.

7.translation: So whoever does an atom’s weight[4] of good will see it,

8.translation: and whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.
